subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this provider-backed WeChat hot-reload fix include redacted live A+B QR-login proof before merge, or is the focused gateway lifecycle coverage sufficient for this narrowly bounded handoff?
rationale: The contributor has exhausted the mechanical review findings and cannot access a real WeChat A+B setup; accepting test-only evidence for this provider-backed lifecycle behavior is a maintainer quality-bar decision.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until someone with a real QR-login setup supplies redacted evidence that account A stays online after account B is added.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused gateway regressions and normal validation as sufficient for this lifecycle change, then proceed through ordinary exact-head checks.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until someone with a real QR-login setup supplies redacted evidence that account A stays online after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged multi-account gateway reload implementation and are the closest evidenced owner of the shared lifecycle boundary.
